rationale: The agent submitted the exchange without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. Additionally, the user’s request to receive the price difference as a gift card (if possible) was not addressed; the agent processed a refund to PayPal without explanation or confirmation. While tool calls suggest the agent identified the user and the correct order (#W9502127) and executed an exchange to a bagless canister model, the lack of explicit confirmation and failure to handle or explain the refund method preference mean the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
